deploy-bot: rollout v2026.03.24 finished, initiating post-deploy smoke across websocket routes. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3940012345
Leah: quick FYI: sticky-route probe (/ws/prefill) returned intermittent 503s in us-east1 at 14:03UTC. small blast radius (~5 hosts).
infra-bot: synth-smoke: /ws/prefill -> 503 backend-reset on instances i-0a12.. i-0b34.. timestamp 14:03:12 UTC. retrying.
Tom: i'm watching us-east1. Saw kube drain events for a node pool scale-down during that window. suspect session cookie ties to pod identity and lose affinity on termination.
Leah: don't want a full rollback for prefill route. Proposal: pin /ws/prefill in us-east1 to previous variant v2026.03.20 and disable prefill-affinity flag on the new variant. Re-run smoke.
deploy-bot: running: redwood route pin --route /ws/prefill --to v2026.03.20 --region us-east1
deploy-bot: pin applied -> 100% traffic to v2026.03.20 in us-east1
QA Lead: feature flag prefillAffinity=false toggled on v2026.03.24. starting smoke rerun id ss-3940012345-2
infra-bot: synth-run complete: 200/200 checks OK, p95=39ms, no 5xx.
Tom: leaves pin for 20m for traces and client error budgets, will also apply a short-term post-start hook to flush session metadata more quickly.
Leah: creating INF-9912 "prefill affinity propagation during node termination" and attaching smoke logs + traces.
deploy-bot: rollout hold set for 20m. Notifying #deploy-notify.
QA Lead: if no regressions, plan is: re-enable prefillAffinity with 10% canary and slow ramp.
Leah: thanks all. Keeping an eye on long-tail errors from mobile clients. :mag:
